subject: Request: 5-day pilot runway extension while procurement completes security signoff
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Morrow <elena.morrow@synergenix.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 5-day pilot runway extension while procurement completes security signoff

Hi Elena —

Quick note following our call: I understand SynerGenix's procurement team is running a short SOC2/security checklist and that PO routing may slip a few days. To avoid losing momentum on the sandbox integration, would Redwood be able to provision a 5-day pilot runway extension (same environment, additional 150k tokens) while your security team finalizes signoff?

If that works, I can send a short top-up plan and link it to the existing deal so it shows up in your procurement notes. We won't change billing terms — this is strictly to keep the demo/live integration warm so your engineers can finish verification.

CCing Camila (CS) to track usage and Vanessa (customer success) for scheduling handoffs. If you need a PO or an updated SOW snapshot to attach internally I can fire that over.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: SOW_summary.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Elena Morrow <elena.morrow@synergenix.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@synergenix.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 5-day pilot runway extension while procurement completes security signoff

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the proactive reach. Procurement/security have bumped our timeline after discovering a vendor security addendum that needs review; we expect the review to complete by 2027-05-22.

A couple quick asks so I can get internal buy-in:
- Can you confirm the exact token/top-up amount and the window (start/end)?
- Will this extension require any additional legal sign-off or amendment to the current trial terms?

I've looped in Peter from finance to confirm we can accept the temporary top-up on our existing onboarding track. If you can send the short top-up plan and a one-page SOW snapshot we can attach to the security ticket.

Elena
Head of Product
SynerGenix
elena.morrow@synergenix.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Morrow <elena.morrow@synergenix.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 5-day pilot runway extension while procurement completes security signoff

Elena — thanks. Confirming details below so you can drop them into the security/finance ticket:

- Top-up: 150,000 tokens (mixed generation/embedding use)
- Window: 2027-05-18T00:00:00Z through 2027-05-22T23:59:59Z (5 calendar days)
- Terms: No change to existing trial terms; no additional legal amendment required — this is a limited, zero-cost runway extension applied to your demo environment.

I've attached a short plan (pilot_topup_plan.xlsx) that shows the token allocation and rollback rules (Camila will monitor and cap usage). We will also add a note to the HubSpot deal referencing this temporary top-up.

If procurement needs a one-line confirmation from our finance team for their ticket, let me know and I can have Vanessa escalate.

Cheers,
Rishi
Attachment: pilot_topup_plan.xlsx (XLSX stub)
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2419
From: Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@synergenix.com>
To: Elena Morrow <elena.morrow@synergenix.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 5-day pilot runway extension while procurement completes security signoff

Rishi — this is fine from our side. Procurement expects to clear the security addendum by 5/22 and finance confirms we can accept the temporary top-up under the existing onboarding terms. No PO required for the 5-day runway; we'll proceed with the signed PO once the review completes.

Peter Lowe
Finance Manager | SynerGenix
